name: Horizon by WPmation
author: wpmation

sections.description:
Horizon by WPmation analyzes your WordPress site and its environment to highlight visible players, gaps, strengths, weaknesses, offers, and opportunities to explore.

Horizon focuses on growth opportunities and does not replace native WordPress tools or a specialized SEO audit.

The plugin is free and distributed under the GPLv2 license or later.

How It Works

  1. You voluntarily start an analysis from the WordPress administration area.
  2. Horizon by WPmation sends the information required to the official WPmation analysis service.
  3. The service analyzes the site and its environment, then builds the report.
  4. The result is displayed in WordPress and can be exported as a PDF.

The analysis covers, among other things:

  • your site and its visible signals;
  • the concepts that structure your environment;
  • competing sites or visible players;
  • observed differences;
  • detectable offers and pricing signals;
  • identified gaps and opportunities.

The results are analytical indications and do not guarantee traffic, rankings, or commercial results.

External Service

Horizon by WPmation relies on an official remote analysis service operated by WPmation. Analysis is triggered only after an administrator voluntarily starts an analysis from WordPress.

The service may process the site’s URL, name, and necessary technical information, as well as publicly accessible content required to produce the report.

  • Documentation: https://wpmation.com/horizon/
  • Privacy Policy: https://wpmation.com/politique-de-confidentialite/
  • Terms and Conditions: https://wpmation.com/conditions-generales-de-ventes-utilisation/

Privacy

Horizon by WPmation does not automatically send data to its analysis service: data is sent when an administrator starts an analysis.

The service may retrieve public pages, robots.txt, and sitemaps from the analyzed site. Avoid using the tool to transmit or analyze confidential information that is not necessary for your request.

Processing states and reports may be retained temporarily, for up to 30 days, by the service to support execution, tracking, and delivery of the analysis.

See the WPmation Privacy Policy for detailed information about data processing.

Support

For questions, suggestions, or issues related to Horizon by WPmation:

https://wpmation.com/contact

Documentation

https://wpmation.com/horizon/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Horizon by WPmation from the WordPress administration area.
  2. Start an analysis from the Horizon by WPmation dashboard.
  3. Review the results and, if needed, export the report as a PDF.
sections.faq:
Is Horizon by WPmation really free?

Yes. Horizon by WPmation is a free WordPress plugin distributed under the GPLv2 license or later.

Is Horizon a traditional SEO audit?

No. Horizon focuses on analyzing a site’s environment, visible players, observed gaps, and potential opportunities. It does not replace a technical SEO audit or native WordPress tools.

Why are some sites classified as visibility sources?

A visible result in a search environment is not necessarily a commercial competitor. A platform, editorial source, or other player may contribute to the visibility of a topic without being directly comparable to the analyzed site.

Why might a price not appear?

Horizon does not create pricing data. A pricing signal is shown only when usable pricing information is detected in the analyzed content.

Does a detected opportunity have to be acted on?

No. The opportunities presented by Horizon are analysis leads. Their relevance depends on your business, objectives, resources, and market context.

How long does it take to receive the report?

The duration depends in particular on the amount of data and pages to be analyzed. The WordPress administration area displays the processing status while the analysis is running.

For the complete documentation and detailed information about Horizon by WPmation:

https://wpmation.com/horizon/
sections.changelog:
0.1.18

  • Added a new educational interface explaining the main stages of the Horizon by WPmation analysis.
  • Improved the presentation of the analysis journey from site analysis to opportunity identification.
  • Improved the contextual understanding and structuring of websites and online stores.
  • Improved competitor pricing data extraction and interpretation.
  • Enhanced comparative analysis using detected pricing information.
  • Improved the presentation and consistency of analysis results.
  • General analysis process optimizations.

0.1.17

  • Improved weakness interpretation for visibility sources and platforms.
  • Improved price detection and added a category sample for stores.
  • Clarified market gaps and pricing language.
  • Improved spacing and content centering in report cards.

0.1.16

  • Improved PDF card presentation with better content centering and spacing.
  • Visibility sources such as YouTube and Wikipedia are no longer treated as pricing signals.
  • The report excludes these sources from pricing comparisons.

0.1.15

  • Switched to the official public Horizon analysis service.
  • Strengthened separation between the distributed plugin and service-side processing.
  • Improved the public service configuration and documentation.
  • Declared compatibility with WordPress 7.1.

0.1.14

  • Added GPLv2 or later license information to the plugin headers.
  • Added privacy information to the WordPress Privacy Policy Guide.
  • Expanded documentation of the remote analysis service and processed data.
  • Clarified service configuration in wp-config.php.
